product_family: Voice AI platform for AI-powered dubbing, speech-to-speech translation, voice cloning, and conversational AI agent voices. Serves media & entertainment (5,000+ titles localized), live broadcast, and enterprise contact centers.

certifications.name: SOC 2
certifications.proof_quote: Deepdub successfully completed a SOC 2 audit with a 'clean' audit opinion from auditors. The framework covers controls related to security, availability, processing integrity, confidentiality, and privacy.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type (I or II)
certifications.proof_quote: SOC 2 Type designation not publicly specified; Type I vs Type II not disclosed in audit announcement.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO 27001 certification found despite comprehensive search of vendor domain and external sources.

certifications.name: GDPR Compliance
certifications.proof_quote: Privacy Policy explicitly references GDPR Article 6 legal bases and data transfers are governed by Standard Contractual Clauses published by the EU Commission for USA transfers. Privacy Policy states GDPR compliance and Data Processing Addendum (Exhibit A) included in Terms.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of HIPAA certification or claims. Product is primarily for media/entertainment and enterprise voice, not healthcare-specific.

certifications.name: TPN Gold Shield (Motion Picture Association Trusted Partner Network)
certifications.proof_quote: Deepdub has earned the Trusted Partner Network (TPN) Gold Shield certification from the Motion Picture Association (MPA). Deepdub is the first AI dubbing solution to receive content security accreditation from the MPA's Trusted Partner Network.

certifications.name: ISO 27017 (Cloud-specific information security)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO 27017 certification.

certifications.name: ISO 27018 (Cloud PII protection)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO 27018 certification.

certifications.name: ISO 42001 (AI management system)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO/IEC 42001 certification found.

certifications.name: CSA STAR
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of Cloud Security Alliance STAR certification.

privacy.ai_training_note: Terms explicitly state: 'Deepdub will not use customer inputs to train, fine-tune, develop, modify, or otherwise improve its artificial intelligence models.' Optional no-retention mode available post-processing.
privacy.data_region: Israel (primary) and USA (with EU Standard Contractual Clauses for transfers). Data stored and processed outside European Economic Area.

security.name: Encryption in Transit
security.value: End-to-end encryption implemented; specific protocols not detailed publicly.

security.name: Data Retention
security.value: Personal data retained only as long as reasonably necessary for stated purposes and legal requirements. Optional no-retention mode available.

security.name: Service Level Agreement (SLA)
security.value: 99.95% monthly uptime guarantee for API, excluding scheduled maintenance. Service credits available if SLA breached.

security.name: Infrastructure Security
security.value: AWS Marketplace partner with AWS Partner Network verification. TPN-certified infrastructure with isolated secure voice assets approved for studios and broadcasters.

security.name: General Security Standard
security.value: Follows generally accepted industry standards to protect against unauthorized access; acknowledges no method 100% secure.

products.name: Voice API for Agents
products.data_scope: Real-time voice generation for AI agents; ~125ms end-to-end latency for live calls.
products.notes: Production-ready, multilingual (100+ languages), SOC 2 and GDPR compliant.

products.name: AI Dubbing (Media & Entertainment)
products.data_scope: Video dubbing, speech-to-speech translation, voice cloning for 5,000+ titled globally.
products.notes: TPN Gold Shield certified, end-to-end delivery from voice creation through QC, theatrical-grade quality.

products.name: Deepdub GO
products.data_scope: FAST channel and streaming content localization; self-service platform.
products.notes: Enables rapid content localization; used for news and commercial content.

products.name: Live Dubbing & Voice Cloning
products.data_scope: Frame-accurate timing for broadcast video; persistent voice identity across programs.
products.notes: Broadcast-safe licensing; proven in live broadcast conditions.
